about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The judo strategy applied to marketing.
about.intro: In judo, the biggest fighter doesn't win, the one who uses momentum in their favor does. Judo Marketing was born from that philosophy: helping small and medium businesses compete against giants using technology, artificial intelligence, and strategy as leverage.

sections.title: Use the market's momentum
sections.description: You don't need a corporation's budget. You need to position yourself where the market is already moving: Google searches, social media, and AI automation that works while you sleep.

sections.title: Honesty first
sections.description: In the initial interview we tell you frankly whether we can deliver your project. No smoke, no inflated promises: if we don't deliver your project in under a month, we refund your first payment.

sections.title: Shared prosperity
sections.description: We grow when you grow. That's why every website includes your own control portal, and once you complete your contract year the code is completely yours.
